title: MacCrab Rave Kit (v0)
description: Schema for a .maccrabkit — a curated bundle of plugins for a specific operator scenario. Per plan §9.3. Kit trust tier is computed as min(plugin.trust_tier for plugin in plugins).

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for IDE autocomplete.

id.description: Reverse-DNS kit identifier with `.kit.` segment. Globally unique across the rave catalog. Example: com.maccrab.kit.ir-quick.

description.description: Operator-facing description of what scenario this kit serves. Length-capped for the same reason manifest description is (plan §11 A8 prompt-injection surface).

maintainer.description: Display name or handle of the kit maintainer. First-party kits use `MacCrab`.

plugin_id.description: Reverse-DNS plugin id; must exist in rave/catalog/<id>.json

role.description: One-sentence explanation of why this plugin is in this kit

required.description: If false, the kit is functional without this plugin but it adds value

trust_tier.description: Computed: minimum trust tier across all member plugins. Rendered at the catalog browser; not authoritative (the per-plugin tier is the truth).

encrypted.description: True if any member plugin requires an encrypted scan (privacy_class personal-comms/content). Surfaced as a kit-level pill. Kits are Ed25519-signed via a detached .sig against catalog.pub (not an embedded hash).
